【EFN3.0 · 全新武器与战斗机制介绍】
【EFN3.0 · New Weapons & Combat Mechanics】

首先，谨向所有参与《EpicFight-Nightfall 3》制作的成员致以诚挚感谢：超级厉害宝宝全体成员、P1nero、Merlin204、东非大野猪，以及每一位支持我们的朋友！
First and foremost, we would like to thank everyone who contributed to EpicFight-Nightfall 3: the entire Super Awesome Baby team, P1nero, Merlin204, dfdyz, and every friend who has supported us!

加入Patreon：Super_Awesome_Baby | A Minecraft modder | Patreon 以支持我们有足够资金继续开发其他模组！您将在之后获得后续的抢先测试模组

Support us on Patreon: Super_Awesome_Baby | A Minecraft modder | Patreon. Your support helps fund the continued development of our mods, and patrons will receive early access to future test builds.

推荐添加aaa粒子以获得GuHao制作的部分特效 (版本>= 2.0)

We recommend installing AAA Particles to enable some of the visual effects created by GuHao (version 2.0 or later).

在经过长时间的开发与等待后，我们终于将 EpicFight-Nightfall 升级至全新版本——Nightfall 3。本次更新重点扩展了动画框架，引入多款精心设计的武器，涵盖以下内容：
After a long period of development, EpicFight-Nightfall has finally evolved into Nightfall 3. This update greatly expands the animation framework and introduces a collection of carefully designed weapons featuring:

完全手绘制作的数百个流畅动画
Hundreds of smooth, fully hand-crafted animations

每类武器配备独立建模与视觉设计
Each weapon type features its own model and visual design

支持运镜动画、特效实体与着色器
Camera animations, effect entities, and shaders

每种武器具备独特的战斗机制与操作手感
Unique combat mechanics and handling for every weapon

⚔️ 武器与技能一览：
⚔️ Weapons & Skills Overview:

▪ 残骸大剑
▪ Ruin Greatsword

抗争：按下 Key3 发动上挑斩，若与敌人攻击相撞可抵消伤害并触发强力连击
Struggle: Press Key3 to perform an upward slash. If it clashes with an enemy attack, the incoming damage is negated and a powerful combo is triggered.

蛮勇：同时按住左右键蓄力，攻击命中的瞬间可抵消所受伤害
Bravado: Hold both mouse buttons to charge. When the charged attack connects, it negates incoming damage at the moment of impact.

▪黄昏之火
▪Duskfire

余火：能量满时同时按住左右键蓄力，挥动引发火焰风暴，可转为横扫或突刺；火焰极致时覆盖全身，强化攻击
Embers: When the energy gauge is full, hold both mouse buttons to charge and unleash a firestorm. The attack can transition into either a sweep or a thrust. At maximum flame, fire envelops the wielder and empowers their attacks.

爆燃：处于“黄昏之火”状态下按 Key3 释放全部火焰与风暴力量
Ignition: While in the Duskfire state, press Key3 to unleash the full power of the flames and storm.

▪ 远古幽匿对刀
▪ Ancient Echo Blades

处决：短按 Key3 挑飞敌人，长按追加终结一击
Execution: Tap Key3 to launch the enemy, or hold it to follow up with a finishing strike.

预感：在受击瞬间闪避可快速位移并反击
Premonition: Dodge just before being hit to quickly reposition and counterattack.

▪ 先锋军佩刀
▪ Vanguard Saber

溃防：按下 Key3 先发动快斩抢占先机，再以剑柄击破防御
Breach: Press Key3 to seize the initiative with a swift slash, then break the enemy's guard with a hilt strike.

▪ 放逐之刃
▪ Blade of Exile

双持特定武器时，左键与 Key3 组合将触发不同招式
When dual-wielding certain weapons, combining left-click attacks with Key3 triggers different moves.

▪ 女皇短刃
▪ Queen's Short Blade

重演：按下key3，下次攻击将附加3.5秒前的一次伤害

Replay: Press Key3 to make your next attack repeat an instance of damage dealt 3.5 seconds earlier.

▪ 狂野爪
▪ Wild Claws

狂暴：按下 Key3 进入狂暴状态，免疫控制、提升移速与攻击，但承受更多伤害
Frenzy: Press Key3 to enter a frenzied state, gaining immunity to crowd control, increased movement speed, and increased attack power, but also taking more damage.

▪ 血癫狂 / 噬骨血癫
▪ Blood Mania / Bone-Devouring Blood Mania

血祭：按下 Key3 献祭血液激活魔刃，进入黑白红视觉模式，攻击释放血色剑气，但同时持续损失生命
Blood Sacrifice: Press Key3 to sacrifice blood and awaken the demonic blade. The world shifts to black, white, and red, and attacks launch blood-red sword waves, but your health continuously drains.

▪ 阎魔刀 + 幻影剑
▪ Yamato + Phantom Swords

高度还原《DMC》维吉尔战斗风格，含大量专属动画。鼓励玩家自主探索连招与机制，真正掌握其力量
Faithfully recreates Vergil's combat style from DMC with a large set of exclusive animations. Players are encouraged to discover its combos and mechanics for themselves and truly master its power.

▪ 高频村雨
▪ HF-MURASAMA

▪ 楔丸+不死斩-拜泪
▪ Kusabimaru + Mortal Blade - HaiRui

▪ 基萨的刺轮
▪ Ghiza's Wheel

▪ 赤月
▪ Crimson Moon

▪ 抗战大刀
▪ Warriors' Broadsword

▪ 傩面偃月
▪ Crescent Moon

 

▪ 夜幕武技
▪ Nightfall Combat Arts

【裂空审判】『Judgement Cut End』

【斬切模式】『Blade Mode』

【重力践踏】『Gravity Stomp』

【猎魂】『Soul Hunt』

【不死斩-拜泪】『Mortal Blade-HaiRui』
